column1: # Custom partition table for ESP32-C3-FH4 (4MB flash).
#   - nvs / otadata / ota_0 / ota_1 / spiffs  (all required by ADR-0010)
# ADR-0010 lists spiffs at 0x3F000; with the other sizes that totals
# 0x406000 (> 4MB = 0x400000) which overflows flash. spiffs is sized
# down to 0x39000 so the table sums exactly to 4MB:
# OTA is deferred to v2 (ADR-0008) but the dual ota_0/ota_1 layout and
# otadata are planned here so a later partition change is not painful.
